name: Bluesky
description: Post to Bluesky, read an account's posts with their engagement counts, search public posts, and read a profile.
intentHints: how did my bluesky posts do
search bluesky for mentions of us
_authNote: An APP PASSWORD, not the account password. Bluesky's own OAuth is DPoP-based and disproportionate for this surface; an app password is issued in one screen and revoked independently. The platform trades it for a short-lived session on every call.

credentialFields.label: Handle
credentialFields.help: Your full Bluesky handle, including the domain.
credentialFields.patternHelp: Include the domain, like alice.bsky.social — not just the name.

credentialFields.label: App password
credentialFields.help: Bluesky → Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords. Never your account password.
credentialFields.patternHelp: An app password is four groups of four separated by dashes. Your account password will not work here.

credentialFields.label: Server
credentialFields.help: Only if you host your own PDS. Leave blank for a normal Bluesky account.

providedTools.description: Publish a post. Bluesky's limit is 300 characters and the tool refuses anything longer rather than letting the API truncate it. Any URL in the text is linked automatically.
An account's own posts with like, repost and reply counts. Defaults to the connected account; pass `actor` (a handle or DID) to read someone else's public posts.
Search public Bluesky posts by keyword. Use it to find mentions of a brand or people discussing a topic.
A profile with follower, following and post counts. Defaults to the connected account; pass `actor` for someone else.
